name: P-013 run50 current-source isolated two-host Papercup chat acceptance
summary: The frozen isolated operator desktop and external portal both rendered and persisted the same choice-card interaction and markdown prose on current source, rejected duplicate answers with HTTP 409, rendered compact inline semantic timestamps for same-day and older turns, and exposed Papercup identity to assistive technology without visible role text. The portal model needed three identical card-prompt submissions: two explicit tool-unavailable misses followed by the successful persisted chat:ask_choice call. The verifier tore down with exit=0.

assertions.evidence: Both hosts used card prompt SHA-256 a263b284f284a07f95b5844c16df9cf171db6e6da9310222b34258dc21dba899 and prose prompt SHA-256 3c27fbad8472865ea2eb989de6fbcaa93d8166060f151d5fce23d66b81d7950c.
Tauri recorded the visible question 'Choose P013 parity token', exactly Alpha/Beta options, persisted chat:ask_choice input, and answered pick Alpha on its first submission.

Portal recorded the same visible question and Alpha/Beta options, persisted chat:ask_choice input, and answered pick Alpha through the restricted PI tool surface. The first two identical submissions returned explicit tool-unavailable prose; the third emitted the required tool call and is the interaction asserted here.
Both hosts' second card-response attempts returned HTTP 409 after the Alpha answer had persisted.
Both DOM snapshots contained strong text 'P013 parity bold', list items first/second, and inline code 'inline' after one prose submission.
Both hosts rendered same-day HH:MM labels and an older 'Sep 7 · HH:MM' label in the message line beside content; every inspected time carried a parseable ISO dateTime and was visible.
Both DOM snapshots reported zero visible assistant-role labels and screen-reader-only 'Papercup' labels; the desktop snapshot also recorded avatar icons.
Desktop DOM reported hostTrust=owner; portal DOM reported hostTrust=public. Portal PI discovery returned HTTP 200 and exposed only voice:delegate_deep and chat:ask_choice.

The frozen operator reported version 0.0.18 and source short SHA ae28cf24ee throughout; portal source HEAD a81782cd844c3200e5d9cfcdccf84325f38c6fe9 with runtime fingerprint e279fa82e812549997c980534d8fd41a9074559b22b77b9d66c3f4a08e60664d over 102 inputs.
